column1: # render_hints.tsv -- the render hints of the served console ([P] Sec. 18.5 "hint"; slot-24 NB-RENDER R1).
# The twin of kHintRows in Console/Bindings/PrintJson.cpp: ConsoleReadOnlyTagValidation arm (H) checks that the
# two agree row for row, in order.  A hint tells the notebook page what a List of Int / String IS
# mathematically (a polynomial, a q-series, an abelian group, ...); it never changes a value or a canonical text.
# Columns (TAB-separated): name (a Record `schema` or a registered type name), path below it (`.` = key or
# member, `[]` = every List element, `*` = any Record key, `m()` = the calls of a member-form object), kind,
# attributes (space-separated key=value, `-` = none).  The coefficient order is checked per verb, never
# assumed: the descent's char_Z is HIGH -> LOW, every other charpoly here LOW -> HIGH.
# kinds: poly (coefficients; order, var, ring), qexp (a_0, a_1, ... of a q-series; ring), abgroup
# ({free_rank, torsion: [[p, k, mult], ...]}), hilbert (a Hilbert function), layers (Loewy / socle layer
# dimensions), partition (a Jordan type); (slot-24 R3) cyclic (exponents e_i of (+)_i Z/ell^{e_i}; ell), eigen (a
# character value P_p in the witness w of the residue field F_ell[w]/(pi_w) = F_{ell^f}; a Poly), lesmap (one map of
# the Dickson long exact sequence, by its name `map`; n, n_up); (slot-24 NB-TOURFIX) factored (a product of polynomials
# with multiplicities: a List of {coefficients, degree, multiplicity, irreducible}; order, var, ring).  An attribute `key=@name` is the Int field or member
# `name`, resolved like the ring parameters (nearest enclosing Record first, then the object).
